##### Project general facts

Edem Villas II is a boutique residential project inspired by the timeless aesthetics of Santorini. This exclusive enclave combines the purity of whitewashed architecture, graceful arches, and open rooftop zones with the natural beauty of Bali's coastline. The development offers a rare blend of Mediterranean elegance and tropical serenity.

Residents and guests are welcomed into a gated community designed for privacy and effortless living. The development features walking paths lined with atmospheric evening lighting, private terraces for quiet moments, and lush green zones that invite relaxation. On-site amenities include a restaurant, a coworking space for productive days, a children's playground, a spa for wellness, and convenient parking. Every element is crafted to support a balanced lifestyle where comfort and convenience are seamlessly intertwined.

Each villa at Edem Villas II is a tribute to light, space, and the horizon. The interiors reflect the project's architectural philosophy, with clean lines, bright open spaces, and finishes that evoke the timeless charm of the Greek islands. Villas range from intimate one-bedroom residences to expansive three-bedroom layouts, all designed with meticulous attention to detail. The fully equipped kitchens, elegant bathrooms, and thoughtfully appointed living areas create a sanctuary of understated luxury, ready to welcome residents from the moment of arrival.

##### Parking

Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the heart of Badung, this exceptional location places residents just steps from the Indian Ocean along a main thoroughfare leading to some of Bali's most prestigious beaches and resorts. Badung is renowned as the island's premier enclave for luxury hospitality, home to an array of five-star properties, world-class golf courses, and exclusive marina facilities. This refined setting offers a serene atmosphere while maintaining effortless access to the region's finest amenities.

The surrounding landscape is defined by its natural beauty and sophisticated infrastructure. Lush tropical jungles meet pristine coastline, creating a backdrop of rare tranquility. Nearby, residents have access to an elite golf club, tennis facilities, a vibrant shopping center, and a collection of white-sand beaches. The area is also conveniently positioned for those who appreciate both leisure and connectivity, with the international airport within easy reach.

For discerning travelers and residents alike, Badung represents the pinnacle of coastal living in Bali. Its blend of security, elegance, and world-class hospitality has long attracted an international community seeking both privacy and prestige. With its calm beaches, manicured landscapes, and reputation as a haven of refined comfort, this regency offers an unparalleled setting for those who value serenity without compromising on sophistication.
